# Vendored code

## qrcode.js

QR Code Generator for JavaScript 1.4.4, by Kazuhiko Arase (<https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator>),
unchanged, from the npm package `qrcode-generator@1.4.4` (sha256 of the file:
`18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`). The web console (0.39.0) uses it to draw the
QR code that pairs a phone: on the Pi, offline, nothing sent anywhere. It makes no request and touches no page by
itself; `console.js` reads its modules and draws them as dark squares on white with a four-module margin.

"QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
